title: WS9 row S11 (resume legacy session) vs our llm-proxy — seat qwen3.8-27b (responses wire, vLLM-dialect). Headless salvage probe (RT-R2 resume lineage): a pre-seeded session in the LEGACY persisted format — the seed schema is pinned from the 01a09be2 incident session (an old-binary-era chat_history.jsonl: system/user/assistant rows, pre-47b format) — is then resumed through the fresh binary of record (the first turn is a --resume of the seeded session id; three resumed turns total). Verdict semantics: PASS = the new binary resumes the old-format session coherently — the legacy history is actually replayed into the wire (the seed text appears in the resumed requests — the resume READ the old-format file, not a fresh session), T2/T3 complete with exact terminal text, exit 0, no request storm. The format-migration surface is the semantic-diff dimension (recon-plan L130-131: the persistence formats of the old and new binaries are the intentionally-evolved surface — semantics: what survives the migration, not byte-identity): (1) legacy history replayed (scored — the seed marker in a resumed request), (2) encrypted_content marker replay (recon — the OQ-3 documented residual: updates.jsonl replay restores markers → a 503+strip self-heal cycle; a 503 storm inflating the request count = S3), (3) session store round-trip (the runner's session-evidence copy). FAIL (S3 report-and-stop) = the resume crashes/rejects the legacy session, or a 503+strip storm (>6 model requests). Suite note: 'salvage' (state-recovery probe) is the closest existing suite enum — a 'session-resume' enum value is PROPOSED additively for the coordinator (naming only; the case is fully expressible as-is). PROP mapping: OQ-3 residual (observation); no standing PROP.

ndjson.label: RESUME CHAIN ALIVE: the second resumed turn completed (the session survived the legacy-format resume and a subsequent turn).
FINAL RESUMED TURN: the last resumed turn completed with the exact terminal text (drift-anchored done pin).

wire.label: LEGACY HISTORY REPLAYED: the OLDEST resumed request carries the seeded legacy-format history (the resume actually READ the old-format chat_history.jsonl — a fresh-session start would not replay the seed; this is the resume claim's discriminating pin).

NO 503+STRIP STORM: 3 resumed turns + side calls fit 3-6; >6 = the OQ-3 residual (updates.jsonl marker replay) fired a 503+strip cycle storm = defect (S3); a single recovered 400/503 within the cap is the documented self-healing residual (record, not stop — OQ-3).

OQ-3 RESIDUAL RECORD: records any captured request line carrying encrypted_content markers on the resumed legacy history (the marker-replay surface — 0 hits = clean replay; hits = the 503+strip self-heal cycle class, cross-check the count pin). recon — always records, never fails.
VERDICT RECORD: merged ndjson final text head (the final resumed turn's output, verbatim). recon — always records, never fails.
